citation_or_source: This run, Foldseek TM-align vs PDB100 on AF-Q8IV36-F1 residues 1-600
claim_tested: HID1 contains a recognisable known fold
key_finding: Residues 1-600 reach TM 0.54 against Ric-8A:Gai (6TYL) and 0.42-0.51 against WAPL, p120-catenin and APC ARM domains. All top hits are ARM/HEAT alpha-solenoids.
organism_assay_context: human sequence, AlphaFold DB v6 model
limitations: TM 0.54 is just over the 0.5 same-fold convention. The fold is in the N-terminal 1-600, not the C-terminal region the hypothesis targeted. Fold identity does not fix ligand chemistry in this superfamily.

citation_or_source: This run, geometric analysis of AF-Q8IV36-F1
key_finding: 63 percent helix over 33 helices. 21 helices in 1-600 fit a circle of radius 32.9 A with centroid rmsd 4.0 A over a 180 degree arc. Rg 31.0 A vs 27.7 A globular expectation, axial ratio 2.13.
limitations: Secondary structure assigned by CA distance rules, not DSSP. Superhelical fit is descriptive.

citation_or_source: This run, Foldseek 3Di-AA and TM-align on residues 690-788
claim_tested: The conserved C-terminal region contains a lipid-binding or Arf/Rab-binding module
key_finding: 0 PDB100 hits in 3Di-AA mode. One TM-align hit, 3JA1 at TM 0.26 over 39 residues. AFDB-SwissProt returns only HID1 orthologs.
limitations: A 99-residue fragment is near the lower length limit for reliable structure search. A novel module would also return no hits.

citation_or_source: This run, 13-ortholog projection onto human numbering, burial by neighbour count, 200 size-matched random draws
claim_tested: Conserved surface patches mark a ligand site
key_finding: 31 residues are exposed, pLDDT > 70 and at least 85 percent similar across 13 orthologs. Largest spatial cluster 5 residues at 12 A linkage against a null of 5.7 +/- 1.7, empirical p = 0.745. Same negative at 10 A (p = 0.300) and 14 A (p = 0.820).
organism_assay_context: Metazoa plus Fungi orthologs, AlphaFold model
limitations: Pairwise Needleman-Wunsch was used because the EBI Clustal Omega REST service refused submissions (HTTP 400, fair-use block). Burial is a neighbour-count proxy, not SASA.

citation_or_source: This run, Pfam PF12722 / InterPro IPR026705 taxonomy counts
claim_tested: The hypothesis prescribed a metazoan, plant and fungal conservation comparison
key_finding: Family counts: Metazoa 2093, Fungi 1556, Viridiplantae 7 (uncharacterised fragments only), Bacteria 0. The plant arm of the prescribed comparison cannot be run.
limitations: Counts reflect the current InterPro release.

citation_or_source: This run, hydrophobic moment and exposed-charge analysis
claim_tested: An amphipathic helix plus a basic membrane-facing surface support TGN association
key_finding: Mean hydrophobic moment of residues 2-20 is 0.718, the 11th percentile of all HID1 11-mers. Exposed residues within 25 A of the myristoylated N-terminus carry net charge -7 over 36 residues (-0.19 per residue) vs -9 over 294 residues (-0.03) beyond. Fisher OR 0.37, p = 0.228, trending opposite to the hypothesis. Only K12, K20, K89 are exposed Lys/Arg within 25 A.
limitations: Single static model. A membrane-bound conformation could differ. The local N-terminal net charge is +3 (K7, R11, K12), consistent with a short polybasic stretch rather than a broad basic face.

claim_tested: HID1 is a peripheral membrane protein of medial and trans Golgi requiring N-myristoylation
key_finding: HID-1 associates with the cytoplasmic face of medial and trans Golgi, is brefeldin A sensitive, shuttles between Golgi and cytosol, and requires its conserved N-terminal myristoylation site for Golgi binding.
limitations: Establishes localisation and anchoring, not molecular activity.

claim_tested: The functional unit is the C-terminal region, not the N-terminus
key_finding: The N-terminus contributes myristoyl plus polybasic membrane affinity without TGN specificity. An isolated TGN-tethered C-terminus rescues secretion and cargo sorting in HID1 knockout cells, and a patient point mutation in that region causes loss of function.
limitations: Defines a functional region, not a biochemical activity or ligand.

citation_or_source: This run, residue-centroid contacts and PAE on AF-Q8IV36-F1
claim_tested: The C-terminal region is a separable domain
key_finding: 438 residue-centroid contacts under 10 A link 690-788 to 1-600. Core-vs-C-terminus mean PAE 9.7 A vs 9.2 A within the core and 7.4 A within the C-terminus, while core-vs-linker is 15.4 A. 42 percent of C-terminal residues lie inside the 32.9 A solenoid radius. Removing 690-788 exposes 72 buried core residues across 8 helical segments at mean pLDDT 93.6.
limitations: PAE is a confidence measure, not a contact measurement. The model is a single predicted state.

citation_or_source: This run, per-residue identity across 13 orthologs
claim_tested: The C-terminal region is the most conserved part of HID1
key_finding: Mean identity to human: C-terminus 690-788 69.5 percent, N-terminus 2-20 64.2 percent, solenoid 21-570 60.8 percent, linker 571-689 45.2 percent.
limitations: Pairwise alignment projection, see E4 limitation.

citation_or_source: This run, IntAct PSICQUIC and STRING physical subnetwork
claim_tested: HID1 is a scaffold for a small GTPase
key_finding: IntAct returns 50 records for Q8IV36, 44 of 50 by two-hybrid. The only small GTPase is HRAS by Y2H. No Rab, Arf, Arl or Rag. No Arf1, AP-1, GGA, golgin, PI4KB or GOLPH3. STRING physical gives only CSDE1 0.841, CBS 0.603, MAGOHB 0.588, CELF3 0.500, TXNL1 0.498, INPPL1 0.456, all experiment-score only.
limitations: Absence of evidence in interaction databases is weak evidence of absence. HID1 is poorly covered by affinity-purification studies.

citation_or_source: This run, Foldseek AFDB-SwissProt, plus PMID:18996921 and PMID:25652408
claim_tested: The closest structural relatives outside the family
key_finding: Yeast ECM30 (Q06673, e = 1.4e-14) and Dymeclin from 9 species (e = 1e-10 to 1e-12, 12-15 percent identity). Dymeclin is itself a peripheral Golgi membrane protein that shuttles and whose loss delays ER-to-Golgi trafficking.
limitations: Shared architecture and shared localisation do not establish shared molecular activity.

citation_or_source: This run, EBI Proteins API variation plus AlphaFold burial
claim_tested: Disease variants mark a functional surface
key_finding: G187D sits at pLDDT 97, neighbour count 21, 69th burial percentile, with no C-terminal contact. R433G/R433W sits at pLDDT 94, neighbour count 17, 47th percentile, at the junction of solenoid, linker and C-terminus, contacting 742 and 744 under 10 A and 493, 494, 632, 636, 637, 638 under 9 A.
limitations: Only 2 pathogenic missense positions. No gnomAD missense at AF > 1e-4 was retrieved, so no powered burial comparison against common variation was possible.

key_finding: Bi-allelic HID1 variants cause infantile encephalopathy with hypopituitarism. R433W fibroblasts keep normal TGN colocalisation but show reduced stimulated extracellular acidification rate.
limitations: Shows the residue matters without identifying the biochemical step.

key_finding: 33 annotations. CC 16, MF 12, BP 5. IPI 12, IDA 7, IBA 6, IEA 4, ISS 2, IMP 1, HDA 1. The only MF term is GO:0005515 protein binding (IPI: PMID:20368287, PMID:25416956, PMID:32296183, PMID:32814053).
